headlines: Carvana Co. Announces Private Exchange Offers Relating To Existing Notes; Shares Move Higher
Carvana Says For The Three Months Ending March 31, 2023, We Expect Retail Units Sold To Be Between 76,000 And 79,000 Units; Expects Total Net Sales And Operating Revenues To Be Between $2.4B-$2.6B
Carvana Says For The Three Months Ending March 31, 2023 Expects Total Gross Profit Per Unit, Non-GAAP To Be Between $4,100 And $4,400
